title: Adaptive Calibration for Fair and Performant Facial Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2606.04469v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Adaptive Calibration (AC), a novel calibration strategy for facial recognition that maps cosine similarity between normalized embeddings to well-calibrated probabilities. By incorporating local context into calibration, Adaptive Calibration corrects for a fundamental mismatch in cosine similarity, whereby the same distance can correspond to different match probabilities in different embedding regions. Our approach improves both overall performance and results in a fairer calibration without requiring demographic metadata.   Our approach often improves worst-group ranking and probability quality across a variety of pretrained models and standard benchmarks, with gains in low-FPR verification performance depending on the setting. translated_title: 面向公平且高性能人脸识别的自适应校准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了自适应校准，这是一种新颖的人脸识别校准策略，可将归一化嵌入之间的余弦相似度映射为良好校准的概率。通过将局部上下文纳入校准过程，自适应校准修正了余弦相似度中一个根本性的不匹配问题，即相同的距离在不同嵌入区域可能对应不同的匹配概率。我们的方法无需人口统计元数据，即可提升整体性能并实现更公平的校准。在多种预训练模型和标准基准测试中，我们的方法通常能改善最差群体的排序性能和概率质量，并在特定设置下提升低误报率（low-FPR）验证性能。自适应校准为公平的人脸识别提供了一种实用的解决方案，既不需要人口群体标注，又能提升整体性能。我们的方法提供了连续的……
tldr: 自适应校准（AC）通过结合局部上下文将余弦相似度映射为良好校准的概率，在无需人口统计信息的情况下同时提升了人脸识别的整体性能与公平性。
en_tdlr: Adaptive Calibration (AC) maps cosine similarity between normalized embeddings to well-calibrated probabilities by incorporating local context, improving both overall facial recognition performance and fairness without requiring demographic metadata.
